distinctions.governing_law: The law chosen to govern the contract (may be subnational).
distinctions.forum: The court, tribunal or arbitration seat chosen for disputes; distinct from governing law.
distinctions.mandatory_regulatory: Mandatory rules or regulators that apply regardless of choice of law.
distinctions.party_domicile: Where the parties are established or served; never evidence of governing law by itself.
distinctions.incorporated_master_agreement: An agreement the document incorporates by reference, which may carry the governing-law and forum clauses.
